t: The Magnusson Beam 600 RS is a rechargeable LED head torch that provides up to 600 lumens of hands-free illumination. Ideal for electricians, plumbers and DIYers working in dark or confined spaces, this unit combines a wide flood beam with a focused spotlight. An integrated motion sensor allows tradespeople to toggle the beam with a simple hand wave, keeping hands free. Featuring a comfortable rubber-coated adjustable headband and an IP54 water-resistant rating, this dependable tool operates for up to 8 hours on a single USB-C charge.
